title: Key Gas Properties (GMVTP)
notes:
Key Properties of Gases

Gaseous State

Intermolecular distance is very high, so molecules are loosely packed. Examples: O₂, H₂, He, NH₃, CO₂.

Mass

Measured in grams or kilograms. IUPAC recommends expressing amount in moles.
n = mass ÷ molar mass

Volume

Equal to the container's volume. Units: mL, cm³, L, dm³.
1 L = 1000 mL

Temperature

Average kinetic energy is proportional to absolute temperature, measured in Kelvin.

Pressure

Force per unit area on container walls (P = F/A).
1 atm = 760 mmHg = 1.01325 × 10⁵ Pa
summary: Gaseous state, mass, volume, temperature, and pressure fundamentals.
